newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank shares touch low for year.
newsitem.headline: Hokkaido Takushoku Bank shares touch low for year.

text.p: Shares in Hokkaido Takushoku Bank Ltd came under further selling pressure on Thursday morning, briefly touching a low for the financial year, due to worries about the financial sector, traders said.
The Japanese city bank was down one yen to 142 yen at 0115 GMT. It briefly slipped to 138 yen, below its previous year low for the business year of 143 yen marked on Wednesday.
Brokers said that the selling of the bank's shares was triggered by a tumble in Nippon Credit Bank Ltd shares on Wednesday that reignited fears about the financial health of Japanese banks.
